FROM "SIS_DEPARTMENT"
JOIN "SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION" ON "SIS_DEPARTMENT"."DEPARTMENT_CODE" = "SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION"."DEPARTMENT"
JOIN "CIS_COURSE_CATALOG" ON "SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION"."DEPARTMENT" = "CIS_COURSE_CATALOG"."DEPARTMENT_CODE"

JOIN "SUBJECT_OFFERED" ON "CIS_COURSE_CATALOG"."MASTER_SUBJECT_ID" = "SUBJECT_OFFERED"."MASTER_SUBJECT_ID"

d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_subject_counts ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_subject_counts.SCHOOL_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME), math_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, ss.avg_subject_codes_per_department, mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.course_count, mcs.min_total_units, mcs.SCHOOL_NAME AS math_school_name, mcs.distinct_course_options FROM school_stats AS WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000), DepartmentMaxCIP AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.max_cip_code, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_full_name FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) > 0), SchoolBudgetStats AS (SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.dept_budget_code_stddev, icte.school_full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.dept_budget_code_stddev, icte.school_full_name) SELECT dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmc.max_cip_code, dmc.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dmc.SCHOOL_NAME, sbs.dept_budget_code_stddev, sbs.school_full_name, sbs.unique_subject_codes FROM DepartmentMaxCIP AS dmc JOIN SchoolBudgetStats AS sbs ON dmc.SCHOOL_NAME = sbs.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmc.max_cip_code DESC

WITH political_science_subjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), department_units_stats AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME, CIP.VERSION FROM `CIP` JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '17'), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(VERSION) AS avg_version FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_version AS school_avg_version, CASE WHEN i.VERSION > s.avg_version * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VERSION' WHEN i.VERSION < s.avg_version * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VERSION' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS version_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME
